C. The ESCO is in the business of providing comprehensive energy management solutions, including energy audits, implementation of energy conservation measures, operation and maintenance of energy systems, and performance contracting.

D. The Parties intend that the ESCO shall implement and finance certain energy conservation measures and provide ongoing energy management services, with the ESCO's compensation being linked to verified energy savings achieved.

**NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, terms, and conditions set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:**

**ARTICLE 1: DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION**

1.1 **"Baseline"** shall mean the energy consumption baseline established for the Premises as set forth in Annexure A, which shall serve as the reference point for calculating energy savings.

1.2 **"Energy Conservation Measures" or "ECMs"** shall mean the specific energy efficiency improvements listed in Annexure B, including but not limited to: replacement of conventional lighting with LED systems, installation of variable frequency drives (VFDs) on HVAC pumps and fans, optimization of the Building Management System (BMS), and installation of solar photovoltaic panels on the rooftop area.

1.3 **"Measurement and Verification" or "M&V"** shall mean the process of quantifying energy savings achieved through the implementation of ECMs, in accordance with the International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol (IPMVP) Option C, as described in Annexure C.

1.4 **"Guaranteed Savings"** shall mean the minimum annual energy savings guaranteed by the ESCO for each Contract Year, as specified in Article 4.

1.5 **"Contract Year"** shall mean each consecutive period of twelve (12) months commencing from the Effective Date, provided that the first Contract Year shall be the period from the Effective Date until the last day of the twelfth (12th) month thereafter.

1.6 **"Effective Date"** shall mean the date of execution of this Agreement as first written above.

1.7 **"Service Fee"** shall mean the monthly fee payable by the Client to the ESCO as set forth in Article 5.

1.8 **"Force Majeure"** shall have the meaning ascribed to it in Article 13.

**ARTICLE 2: SCOPE OF SERVICES**

2.1 The ESCO shall provide the following services to the Client during the term of this Agreement:

(a) Conduct a comprehensive energy audit of the Premises within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date, identifying all viable ECMs;

(b) Design, procure, install, commission, and test all ECMs listed in Annexure B;

(c) Operate and maintain all equipment and systems installed or retrofitted under this Agreement, including the solar PV plant, for the entire term;

(d) Provide ongoing energy management services, including monitoring, analysis, and reporting of energy consumption data;

(e) Implement the M&V plan as described in Annexure C and submit quarterly savings reports to the Client;

(f) Provide training to the Client's facility management staff on the operation and maintenance of the new systems;

(g) Ensure compliance with all applicable central, state, and local regulations, including but not limited to the Energy Conservation Act, 2001, and the building codes of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.

2.2 The ESCO shall assign a dedicated Account Manager who shall serve as the single point of contact for the Client. C. The ESCO is in the business of providing comprehensive energy management solutions, including energy audits, implementation of energy conservation measures, operation and maintenance of energy systems, and performance contracting.

D. The Parties intend that the ESCO shall implement and finance certain energy conservation measures and provide ongoing energy management services, with the ESCO's compensation being linked to verified energy savings achieved.

**NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, terms, and conditions set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:**

**ARTICLE 1: DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION**

1.1 **"Baseline"** shall mean the energy consumption baseline established for the Premises as set forth in Annexure A, which shall serve as the reference point for calculating energy savings.

1.2 **"Energy Conservation Measures" or "ECMs"** shall mean the specific energy efficiency improvements listed in Annexure B, including but not limited to: replacement of conventional lighting with LED systems, installation of variable frequency drives (VFDs) on HVAC pumps and fans, optimization of the Building Management System (BMS), and installation of solar photovoltaic panels on the rooftop area.

1.3 **"Measurement and Verification" or "M&V"** shall mean the process of quantifying energy savings achieved through the implementation of ECMs, in accordance with the International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol (IPMVP) Option C, as described in Annexure C.

1.4 **"Guaranteed Savings"** shall mean the minimum annual energy savings guaranteed by the ESCO for each Contract Year, as specified in Article 4.

1.5 **"Contract Year"** shall mean each consecutive period of twelve (12) months commencing from the Effective Date, provided that the first Contract Year shall be the period from the Effective Date until the last day of the twelfth (12th) month thereafter.

1.6 **"Effective Date"** shall mean the date of execution of this Agreement as first written above.

1.7 **"Service Fee"** shall mean the monthly fee payable by the Client to the ESCO as set forth in Article 5.

EcoPower Solutions has contract with building ESCO contract 2024-2027. Record status: current.

1.8 **"Force Majeure"** shall have the meaning ascribed to it in Article 13.

**ARTICLE 2: SCOPE OF SERVICES**

2.1 The ESCO shall provide the following services to the Client during the term of this Agreement:

(a) Conduct a comprehensive energy audit of the Premises within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date, identifying all viable ECMs;

(b) Design, procure, install, commission, and test all ECMs listed in Annexure B;

(c) Operate and maintain all equipment and systems installed or retrofitted under this Agreement, including the solar PV plant, for the entire term;

(d) Provide ongoing energy management services, including monitoring, analysis, and reporting of energy consumption data;

(e) Implement the M&V plan as described in Annexure C and submit quarterly savings reports to the Client;

(f) Provide training to the Client's facility management staff on the operation and maintenance of the new systems;

(g) Ensure compliance with all applicable central, state, and local regulations, including but not limited to the Energy Conservation Act, 2001, and the building codes of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.

2.2 The ESCO shall assign a dedicated Account Manager who shall serve as the single point of contact for the Client. The Account Manager shall be available during business hours (09:30 hours to 18:00 hours, Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays) and shall respond to all Client communications within one (1) business day.

**THIRD AMENDMENT TO ENERGY SERVICES AGREEMENT**

This Third Amendment ("Third Amendment") is entered into on this 12th day of June, 2026, by and between:

**Greenline Commercial Properties Private Limited** ("Client"), a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 14th Floor, Tower B, Worldmark One, Aerocity, New Delhi – 110037; and

**EcoPower Solutions** ("ESCO"), a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at 501-505, Vipul Plaza, Sector 43, Gurugram, Haryana – 122002.

The Client and the ESCO are individually referred to as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties."

**WHEREAS:**

A. The Parties entered into an Energy Services Agreement dated 15 March 2024, bearing Agreement No. EP-2024-071, as amended by a First Amendment dated 10 September 2024 and a Second Amendment dated 02 February 2025 (collectively, the "Agreement"), for the implementation of energy conservation measures at the Client's commercial complex located at Plot No. 7, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi (the "Premises");

B. The Parties now desire to amend certain provisions of the Agreement relating to the payment mechanism and reporting obligations, as set forth herein.

**NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:**

**ARTICLE 1: AMENDMENTS**

1.1 **Amendment to Section 5.2 (Service Fee Structure).** Section 5.2 of the Agreement is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following:

"5.2 The Service Fee shall be computed on a monthly basis and shall be equal to the sum of:

(a) a fixed base fee of INR 4,85,000 (Indian Rupees Four Lakh Eighty-Five Thousand Only) per month, exclusive of applicable taxes; and

(b) a variable performance fee calculated as 35% of the verified energy cost savings achieved during the applicable month, as determined in accordance with the Measurement and Verification (M&V) Plan set forth in Annexure C.

The variable performance fee shall be payable only if the verified energy savings for the month exceed the Guaranteed Savings Baseline specified in Annexure D. In no event shall the total Service Fee for any month exceed INR 9,50,000 (Indian Rupees Nine Lakh Fifty Thousand Only), exclusive of applicable taxes."

1.2 **Amendment to Section 5.4 (Invoicing and Payment Terms).** Section 5.4 of the Agreement is hereby amended by adding the following new sub-clauses:

"5.4.3 The ESCO shall raise a consolidated monthly invoice for the Service Fee within seven (7) business days following the end of each calendar month. The invoice shall be accompanied by a savings verification report certified by the independent M&V verifier appointed under Annexure C.

5.4.4 The Client shall make payment of the invoiced amount within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice, provided that the invoice is accompanied by the complete savings verification report. In the event of any dispute regarding the invoiced amount, the Client shall pay the undisputed portion within the said thirty (30) day period, and the disputed portion shall be resolved in accordance with Article 14 (Dispute Resolution)."

1.3 **Amendment to Section 8.1 (Reporting Obligations).** Section 8.1 of the Agreement is hereby amended by adding the following new sub-clause:

"8.1.3 In addition to the quarterly savings reports, the ESCO shall submit to the Client, on or before the 10th day of each month, a consolidated monthly performance dashboard containing the following information:

(a) energy consumption and demand data for the preceding month, disaggregated by building system (HVAC, lighting, plug loads, and lifts);
